title: Ceuta Evokes Europe’s 2015 Migration Crisis. But Much Has Changed Since.
summary: The crossing of 50,000 people to Spanish territory this week has created a crisis for the Spanish government, much as the 2015 migration crisis did for Europe’s leaders. The context is different.
